journal: Energies 13, 6295 (Adeniyi, Deering, Marriott: The Saturated Water Content of Liquid Propane in Equilibrium with the sII Hydrate)
experimental_method: Small equilibration loop with hydrate-bearing propane + water; saturated liquid propane flashed through a poppet valve to a tunable diode laser absorption spectrometer (TDLAS) for water content; 241.95-276.12 K, 1-40 MPa.
uncertainties_stated: T +-0.1 K, p +-0.001 MPa (as printed), water content reproducibility 12 ppm at 95 % confidence; TDLAS factory relative accuracy 2 %, stable standard deviation 4 ppm.
quality_remarks: Pressure dependence small; authors compare with Sloan, Song, Song and Kobayashi data. Temperature measured with ITS-90 calibrated PRT. Basis of ppm (mole vs volume) not explicitly stated (text uses ppmv for TDLAS signal).
not_extracted_tables: Table 1: TDLAS validation, gravimetric feed vs measured water in single-phase propane + water; no T or p stated, validation of instrument, 4 rows (yH2O exp 92/152/219/251 ppm vs grav 106/165/223/263 ppm)
